evidence_candidates.excerpt: The ASPLOS 2025 MELODY study evaluates 265 workloads, four CXL devices, seven latency settings, and five processor platforms. It reports workload- and device-dependent behavior, including microsecond-scale tail latency on some devices even at low utilization.
evidence_candidates.statement_supported: MELODY shows that average bandwidth and latency are insufficient to characterize CXL memory because tail latency and workload tolerance vary across devices and platforms.
